decisions.reason: As a recent add-on to the firm's core coolant-management systems, the booster still has positive option value and is inexpensive to retain while market acceptance continues to become clearer.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge fits the firm's established filtration capabilities and installed customer base, so management would likely keep learning from the market rather than abandon it now.
Coolant nozzles are close to the core offer and likely cheap to keep available, although the multi-model line creates some growing risk of later portfolio rationalization.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is somewhat less central than the coolant products, but in a growing machinery market a large diversified supplier would usually continue testing this adjacent option for another year.
Because the magnetic belt chip conveyor extends the firm's existing conveying portfolio and service network with limited incremental commitment, its option value remains favorable.

The hinged belt chip conveyor faces somewhat higher pruning risk as the firm gains more information and compares it with other conveyor variants, yet the evidence is still not strong enough to justify withdrawal.
